name: trip-challenges
description: PWA for photo-challenge school trips. Strict data erasure for minors' data.

scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @trip/shared && npm run dev --workspace @trip/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @trip/shared && npm run dev --workspace @trip/web
scripts.e2e:services: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f e2e/docker-compose.e2e.yml up -d && node e2e/scripts/wait-for-services.mjs
